architecture.mechanism: Dependence through continuous exposure — a system sustained by continuous infusion of an input develops a withdrawal deficit when that input is withdrawn, so function cannot persist after input cessation.
architecture.intervention: Fit the water-powered car with an input-dependence audit analogous to ICU infusion/dose-duration tracking and withdrawal screening: log cumulative water/energy input versus shaft work output, then cut off the single glass of water and continue logging to detect the post-input deficit.
architecture.expected_effect: Once the water input is exhausted, output will show a measurable withdrawal-like decay to zero rather than infinite mileage, demonstrating external-input dependence and compliance with the first and second laws.
architecture.falsification_test: Run the vehicle on one precisely measured glass of water with no other energy input, logging torque and speed until stop; if work output remains constant indefinitely after the water is consumed, the perpetual-motion claim survives — any decay or stop falsifies it.

challenge.kill_reason: all deterministic checks passed; the adversarial gauntlet's objections are ESCALATED (uncalibrated attacker, Art. L) and ride the record for adjudication
